  FROM read_files(
    '/Volumes/workspace/mlpab679845/raw_increments/*.csv',
    format => 'csv',

  )
) s
ON t.row_id = s.row_id AND t.event_time = s.event_time
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
""")

EOF
